<h1>1.前言</h1>
<p>crest是一款海洋模拟插件，其开源的基础版本位于github(<a href="https://github.com/wave-harmonic/crest" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/wave-harmonic/crest</a>)，年末清下Flag，学习下该插件源码。</p>
<p>&nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/519009/202512/519009-20251211153357626-1131174822.jpg" alt="Header" width="586" height="342" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2>1.1.对比Boat Attack</h2>
<p>之前基于BoatAttack（<a href="https://github.com/Unity-Technologies/BoatAttack" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/Unity-Technologies/BoatAttack</a>）做过一套水体方案，对比下两者。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>- Boat Attack Water</strong></p>
<p>BoatAttack没有海底渲染，Lod只有mesh做了远处简化处理，没有系统级Lod的设计。</p>
<p>水体交互通过叠加Gerstner波形实现，但有叠加上限限制。</p>
<p>无FFT波形，只有Gerstner波。</p>
<p>无吃水线、海底实现。</p>
<p>无船只水体交互，只有深度差泡沫效果，海浪是粒子特效。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>- Crest</strong></p>
<p>完整的大规模海面LOD方案，大量ComputeShader处理，但也提供常规VF Shader兼容性支持，需要自己开关。</p>
<p>波形模拟做了封装处理，可自由切换FFT与Gerstner，可自定义某块区域用哪一种。</p>
<p>查询接口做了封装处理，一套接口可以支持异步和非异步。</p>
<p>基础版本没有吃水线，但有完善海底实现。</p>
<p>船只与水体可配置波浪等交互，海浪是GPU Instancing的内置特效。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>1.2 插件结构</h2>
<p>以github上开源的基础版本为例，Examples.unity场景有所有效果演示</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/519009/202512/519009-20251211141707497-1579717908.png" alt="qqq1" width="750" height="358" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>核心逻辑在OceanRenderer中，但要让海洋正常运行需要一定层级结构配置，例如参考BoatScene.unity</p>
<p>Shader部分较为清晰，主要在Ocean.shader中，包含折射、反射、泡沫、SSS等基础的海水实现。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>展开OceanRenderer的Debug菜单后，可显示Tile、线框等。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/519009/202512/519009-20251215095851068-1467842785.png" alt="z2" width="801" height="414" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1>2.Tile &amp; ShiftingOrigin</h1>
<h2>2.1 Tile拼接</h2>
<p>在OceanRenderer脚本处勾选showOceanTileGameObjects即可显示隐藏的Chunk对象</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/519009/202512/519009-20251215095659469-1405616522.png" alt="z1" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>具体代码在OceanBuilder的GenerateMesh中。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>所有Tile都是独立Mesh，替换为Unlit shader查看，会发现有接缝：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/519009/202512/519009-20251215175953805-594058500.png" alt="屏幕截图 2025-12-15 174007" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>Shader中通过SnapAndTransitionVertLayout函数，进行坐标偏移修复，解决接缝问题。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>unlit shader:</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/519009/202512/519009-20251215180236503-1173855969.png" alt="屏幕截图 2025-12-15 174244" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>切回带Snap函数的shader:</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/519009/202512/519009-20251215180255677-639570694.png" alt="屏幕截图 2025-12-15 175437" width="565" height="383" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>但感觉实际上也可以用类似geo mipmap的做法，离线生成一张带顶点缝合的大型Mesh，</p>
<p>实时跟着Camera走（缺点是不好按Tile优化）：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/519009/202512/519009-20251215100508940-293199700.png" alt="z3" width="786" height="596" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2>2.2 ShiftingOrigin实现原理</h2>
<p>当实际坐标大于某阈值时，直接让transform.position减去一定偏移量，实现拉回，从而避免</p>
<p>因浮点数偏差而导致模型出现撕扯问题。</p>
<p>维基百科(<a href="http://wiki.unity3d.com/index.php/Floating_Origin" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">http://wiki.unity3d.com/index.php/Floating_Origin</a>)</p>
<p>插件实现：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>public class<span> ShiftingOrigin : CustomMonoBehaviour
{
    ...
    void<span> FixedUpdate()
    {
        var newOrigin =<span> Vector3.zero;

        if (Mathf.Abs(transform.position.x) &gt;<span> _threshold) ...
        if (Mathf.Abs(transform.position.y) &gt;<span> _threshold) ...
        if (Mathf.Abs(transform.position.z) &gt;<span> _threshold) ...

        if (newOrigin !=<span> Vector3.zero)
        {
            MoveOrigin(newOrigin);
        }
    }
}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h2>2.3 Texel对齐</h2>
<p>为了避免偏移时无法对齐mesh网格，实际还会进行一步Texel偏移操作。</p>
<p>即用最小lod网格的尺寸进行坐标量化，避免shader通过世界坐标采样噪声贴图时，</p>
<p>因为浮点数采样到完全不同的中间位置，造成抖动感。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>有Texel量化对齐的移动：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/519009/202512/519009-20251210151020914-1264442601.gif" alt="未标题-1" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>无Texel量化对齐的移动：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/519009/202512/519009-20251210151043958-407917944.gif" alt="未标题-2" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>代码可参考LodTransform</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>public class<span> LodTransform : IShiftingOrigin
{
    ...

    public void<span> UpdateTransforms()
    {
        for (int lodIdx = 0; lodIdx &lt; LodCount; lodIdx++<span>)
        {
            ...

            // find snap period
            _renderData[lodIdx].Current._textureRes =<span> OceanRenderer.Instance.LodDataResolution;
            _renderData[lodIdx].Current._texelWidth = 2f * camOrthSize /<span> _renderData[lodIdx].Current._textureRes;
            // snap so that shape texels are stationary
            _renderData[lodIdx].Current._posSnapped =<strong> OceanRenderer.Instance.Root.position
                - new Vector3(Mathf.Repeat(OceanRenderer.Instance.Root.position.x, _renderData[lodIdx].Current._texelWidth), 0f, Mathf.Repeat(OceanRenderer.Instance.Root.position.z, _renderData[lodIdx].Current._texelWidth));</strong></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1>3.LOD系统</h1>
<p>可以说整个插件的核心都是围绕着LOD系统，各类模块都继承自LodDataMgr</p>
<p>继承LodDataMgr的模块：</p>
<p>-&nbsp;LodDataMgrAlbedo，类似于Decal</p>
<p>-&nbsp;LodDataMgrAnimWaves，指定波形</p>
<p>-&nbsp;LodDataMgrClipSurface，使用SDF或其他方式裁剪海面</p>
<p>-&nbsp;LodDataMgrDynWaves，动态修改波</p>
<p>-&nbsp;LodDataMgrFlow，通过Crest内部FlowMap和内部样条线，实现类似河流流动效果</p>
<p>-&nbsp;LodDataMgrFoam，泡沫</p>
<p>-&nbsp;LodDataMgrPersistent，中间基类，提供子步骤模拟，以避免物理模拟/查询等出错</p>
<p>-&nbsp;LodDataMgrSeaFloorDepth，维护海平面相对海底的高度数据，生成中间贴图，用于后续的浅水区着色等</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>整体继承关系如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/519009/202512/519009-20251211171943538-1949114909.png" alt="qqqq8" width="766" height="429" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2>3.1 Lod调试</h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/519009/202512/519009-20251211152729294-1588339262.png" alt="qqqq7" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>可通过设置Viewpoint并拖拽，直接调试LOD。</p>
<p>（这里的LOD还包括俯视角拉远，海洋细节也会自动切LOD）</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/519009/202512/519009-20251211153233372-1055267952.gif" alt="未标题-3" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2>3.2 Lod Input组件</h2>
<p>每个Lod模块通过基类的注册代码逻辑，可针对对应模块注册若干Input脚本进行扩展。</p>
<p>以Albedo为例，继承逻辑关系如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/519009/202512/519009-20251211172423098-1680240919.png" alt="qqqq10" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>s_registrar是基类（RegisterLodDataInputBase）中处理对应各类型Input的静态字典，其中OceanInput是List类型</p>
<p>可注册若干Input。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>using OceanInput = CrestSortedList&lt;int, ILodDataInput&gt;<span>;
...
public abstract partial class<span> RegisterLodDataInputBase : CustomMonoBehaviour, ILodDataInput
{
    ...
    static Dictionary&lt;Type, OceanInput&gt; s_registrar = new Dictionary&lt;Type, OceanInput&gt;<span>();

    public static<span> OceanInput GetRegistrar(Type lodDataMgrType)
    {
        if (!s_registrar.TryGetValue(lodDataMgrType, out var<span> registered))
        {
            registered = new<span> OceanInput(Helpers.DuplicateComparison);
            s_registrar.Add(lodDataMgrType, registered);
        }
        return<span> registered;
    }
    ...</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p>注册代码：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>public static void RegisterInput(ILodDataInput input, int queueSortIndex, int<span> subSortIndex)
{
    var registrar = GetRegistrar(typeof<span>(LodDataType));
    registrar.Remove(input);

    // Allow sorting within a queue. Callers can pass in things like sibling index to get deterministic sorting
    int maxSubIndex = 1000<span>;
    int finalSortIndex = queueSortIndex * maxSubIndex + Mathf.Min(subSortIndex, maxSubIndex - 1<span>);

    registrar.Add(finalSortIndex, input);
}</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h2>3.3 Lod的RT绘制</h2>
<p>BuildCommandBuffer是基类LogDataMgr比较重要的接口，</p>
<p>子类重写BuildCommandBuffer自定义CommandBuffer的命令，通过基类工具函数SubmitDraws/SubmitDrawsFiltered</p>
<p>最终拿到Input，绘制Mesh，完成当前组件对应的那张RT的编辑。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>为了说明的更清晰些，看下该插件的渲染流程。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>在渲染管线运行之前，Crest会预先执行LodData的相关操作，完成不同RT的绘制，</p>
<p>被绘制的RT根据LOD级别存放在Texture2DArray中。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/519009/202512/519009-20251211140424455-1283532884.png" alt="Q1" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/519009/202512/519009-20251211140431325-1703748464.png" alt="Q2" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>例如Albedo的所有绘制RT，会绘制至Albedo上，</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/519009/202512/519009-20251211144609326-784744858.png" alt="qqq4" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>并作为Texture2DArray参数传入。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/519009/202512/519009-20251211144727920-1276700860.png" alt="qqqq5" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>不同LOD对应的俯视角相机矩阵存放在LodTransform中</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>public class<span> LodTransform : IShiftingOrigin
{
   ...
   public BufferedData&lt;RenderData&gt;[] <strong>_renderData</strong>;</span></pre>
</div>
<p>远处的Lod将应用更大的俯视角，更低分辨率的贴图。&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>LOD系统的好处是，所有区域信息都是信息化存在的，例如某块区域被标记为海浪，某块区域被标记为河流。</p>
<p>它们不受分辨率影响，会根据观测点位置在<strong>需要的时候</strong>被绘制到<strong>对应的LOD贴图</strong>上，最后交给Ocean shader渲染。&nbsp;</p>
<h1>4.查询&amp;交互</h1>
<h2>4.1 查询</h2>
<p>Crest提供了异步查询接口，允许的异步执行时间为1帧，当到达下一帧时，将强行</p>
<p>完成异步工作。查询逻辑用了双缓冲结构，本帧的异步数据执行时将拿出第二份备用数据，</p>
<p>用于注册新的查询请求。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>以ICollProvider为例，CollProviderBakedFFT是CollProvider的其中一个实现。</p>
<p>QueryData中存放了3个字典：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>class<span> QueryData
{
    public Dictionary&lt;int, int3&gt; _segmentRegistryNewQueries = new Dictionary&lt;int, int3&gt;<span>();
    public Dictionary&lt;int, int3&gt; _segmentRegistryQueriesInProgress = new Dictionary&lt;int, int3&gt;<span>();
    public Dictionary&lt;int, int3&gt; _segmentRegistryQueriesResults = new Dictionary&lt;int, int3&gt;<span>();


    public int RegisterQueryPoints(int ownerHash, Vector3[] queryPoints, int<span> dataToWriteThisFrame)
    {
    }

    public void<span> Flip()
    {
        
    }
}</span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p>当外部执行RegisterQueryPoints进行注册查询时，数据会被加到_segmentRegistryNewQueries。</p>
<p>当外部执行RetrieveDisps尝试取回查询结果时，会从_segmentRegistryQueriesResults中取得。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>当执行Flip时，将更换两套数据，上一轮次的数据回收待查询使用，这一轮次的数据开始异步执行。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>public void<span> Flip()
{
    // Results become the next query input (last stage cycles back to first)
    var nextQueries =<span> _segmentRegistryQueriesResults;
    // In progress queries become results
    _segmentRegistryQueriesResults =<span> _segmentRegistryQueriesInProgress;
    // Newly collected queries are now being processed
    _segmentRegistryQueriesInProgress =<span> _segmentRegistryNewQueries;
    // The old results become the new queries
    _segmentRegistryNewQueries =<span> nextQueries;

    // Clear so if something stops querying it's cleaned out
<span>    _segmentRegistryNewQueries.Clear();

    foreach (var registration in<span> _segmentRegistryQueriesInProgress)
    {
        var age = Time.frameCount -<span> registration.Value.z;

        // If query has not been used in a while, throw it away
        if (age &lt; 10<span>)
        {
            ...
            _segmentRegistryNewQueries.Add(registration.Key, newSegment);
        }
    }
}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;类似的设计在BufferedData中也有体现。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>RetrieveSucceeded接口检查当前是否异步执行结束，可以取得数据。</p>
<p>在BakedFFT中：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>public int<span> Query(
    int<span> i_ownerHash,
    float<span> i_minSpatialLength,
    Vector3[] i_queryPoints,
    float<span>[] o_resultHeights,
    Vector3[] o_resultNorms,
    Vector3[] o_resultVels
    )
{
    ... /*检查异步是否处理完成，尝试取得数据*/
    return allCopied ? (int)QueryStatus.Success : (int<span>)QueryStatus.ResultsNotReadyYet;
}

public bool RetrieveSucceeded(int<span> queryStatus)
{
    return queryStatus == (int<span>)QueryStatus.Success;
}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>而在Gerstner中，由于不需要异步查询，直接返回0：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>public int Query(int i_ownerHash, float i_minSpatialLength, Vector3[] i_queryPoints, float<span>[] o_resultHeights, Vector3[] o_resultNorms, Vector3[] o_resultVels)
{
    ...
    return 0<span>;
}

public bool RetrieveSucceeded(int<span> queryStatus)
{
    return queryStatus == 0<span>;
}</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h2>4.2 查询可视化调试</h2>
<p>通过挂载VisualiseCollisionArea脚本，可对海面区域进行可视化的查询调试。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/519009/202512/519009-20251216112024127-360250816.png" alt="屏幕截图 2025-12-16 111902" width="830" height="454" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2>4.3 循环队列</h2>
<p>循环队列是CPU缓存利用非常高效的数据结构，因为下标循环滚动，不会像栈那样，只有靠近栈顶的一些元素被频繁使用。</p>
<p>如BufferedData：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>public void<span> Flip()
{
    _currentFrameIndex = (_currentFrameIndex + 1) %<span> _buffers.Length;
}</span></span></pre>
</div>
<p>使用双下标的循环队列，可以处理生产者与消费者逻辑，甚至还适用于对象池(释放时，交换释放对象到下标2，下标2前进1)。</p>
<p>插件也有一个双下标循环队列实现：SegmentRegistrarRingBuffer</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>4.4&nbsp;AsyncGPUReadback</h2>
<p>Unity提供了异步GPU数据取回的接口，比如RT转Tex2D用该接口效率会更高，</p>
<p>或者ComputeShader执行结果通过该接口异步返回等。</p>
<p>插件查询部分使用了该接口。</p>
<p>之前写过测试：<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/hont/p/11351273.html" target="_blank">https://www.cnblogs.com/hont/p/11351273.html</a></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>4.5&nbsp;SphereWaterInteraction（水体交互）</h2>
<p>也并非所有LOD组件都走Input扩展，例如SphereWaterInteraction，直接注册到s_Instances中，</p>
<p>并由静态方法SphereWaterInteraction.SubmitDraws调用执行。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>public partial class<span> SphereWaterInteraction : CustomMonoBehaviour, ILodDataInput
{
    internal static List&lt;SphereWaterInteraction&gt; s_Instances = new List&lt;SphereWaterInteraction&gt;<span>();
    void<span> OnEnable()
    {
        ...
        s_Instances.Add(this<span>);
    }

    void<span> OnDisable()
    {
        s_Instances.Remove(this<span>);
    }
public static void SubmitDraws(LodDataMgr manager, int<span> lodIndex, CommandBuffer buffer)

    [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(RuntimeInitializeLoadType.SubsystemRegistration)]
    static void<span> OnLoad()
    {
        ClearInstanceData();
        s_Instances.Clear();
    }
}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>使用水体交互需要在OceanRenderer处勾选CreateDynamicWaveSim，并设置配置文件</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/519009/202512/519009-20251215165222767-13248819.png" alt="z5" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>水体交互的代码是关联到LodDataMgrDynWaves&nbsp;，最后在DynamicWaves这个RT上绘制。</strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>官方Demo的复杂形状用的球体组合的方式。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/519009/202512/519009-20251211175742894-843009443.png" alt="qqqq11" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>4.6&nbsp;BoatProbes/SimpleFloatingObject</h2>
<p>船体模拟通过配置_forcePoints实现浮力</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/519009/202512/519009-20251216112253879-704404481.png" alt="z8" width="650" height="313" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>_forcePoints再通过水面信息查询，得到水面高度后传给Unity Rigidbody实现浮力。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>而船体自身引擎动力，海洋Flow流向信息也会在FixedUpdate中更新。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>而SimpleFloatingObject为简化版逻辑，没有高度查询，但会去取Flow，可让漂浮对象跟着流向移动。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>void<span> FixedUpdateBuoyancy()
{
    var archimedesForceMagnitude = WATER_DENSITY *<span> Mathf.Abs(Physics.gravity.y);

    for (int i = 0; i &lt; _forcePoints.Length; i++<span>)
    {
        var waterHeight = OceanRenderer.Instance.SeaLevel +<span> _queryResultDisps[i].y;
        var heightDiff = waterHeight -<span> _queryPoints[i].y;
        if (heightDiff &gt; 0<span>)
        {
            var force = _forceMultiplier * _forcePoints[i]._weight * archimedesForceMagnitude * heightDiff * Vector3.up /<span> _totalWeight;
            if (_maximumBuoyancyForce &lt;<span> Mathf.Infinity)
            {
                force =<span> Vector3.ClampMagnitude(force, _maximumBuoyancyForce);
            }
            _rb.AddForceAtPosition(force, _queryPoints[i]);
        }
    }
}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1>5.水下渲染Underwater</h1>
<p>Camera挂载UnderwaterRenderer后可进行水下渲染。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/519009/202512/519009-20251215170505770-1122928384.png" alt="z7" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>Shader部分检测是否在水下逻辑：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>half4 Frag(const Varyings input, <strong>const bool</strong><span><strong> i_isFrontFace : SV_IsFrontFace</strong>) : SV_Target
{
    ...
    #if _UNDERWATER_ON
    const bool underwater =<span> IsUnderwater(i_isFrontFace, _CrestForceUnderwater);
    #else
    const bool underwater = false<span>;
    #endif
    
    
bool IsUnderwater(const bool i_isFrontFace, const float<span> i_forceUnderwater)
{
    // We are well below water.
    if (i_forceUnderwater &gt; 0.0<span>)
    {
        return true<span>;
    }

    // We are well above water.
    if (i_forceUnderwater &lt; 0.0<span>)
    {
        return false<span>;
    }

    return !<span>i_isFrontFace;
}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p>可见，直接通过Frag参数进行了判断。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1>6.杂项</h1>
<h2>6.1 UpdateFoam.compute 浪花计算</h2>
<p>插件通过雅可比矩阵求秩的做法，计算当前贴图的收缩/膨胀状态，从而进行浪花绘制。</p>
<p>（同样的做法在OceanHelpersNew.hlsl&nbsp;SampleDisplacementsNormals函数中也有使用）</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>float3 disp =<span> s.xyz;
float3 disp_x = dd.zyy +<span> sx.xyz;
float3 disp_z = dd.yyz +<span> sz.xyz;
// The determinant of the displacement Jacobian is a good measure for turbulence:
// &gt; 1: Stretch
// &lt; 1: Squash
// &lt; 0: Overlap
const float2x2 jacobian = (float4(disp_x.xz, disp_z.xz) - disp.xzxz) /<span> wavesCascadeParams._texelWidth;
// Determinant is &lt; 1 for pinched, &lt; 0 for overlap/inversion
const float det =<span> determinant( jacobian );
foam += 5.0 * simDeltaTime * _WaveFoamStrength * saturate( _WaveFoamCoverage - det + foamBase * 0.7 );</span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>调试下该值，det为1和为0时效果区别。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/519009/202512/519009-20251211150752110-447288506.png" alt="qqqq6" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>6.2 ComputeShader RWTexture2D 直接绘制</h2>
<p>在传统VF Shader中，绘制一张RT需要通过至少2张RT PingPong的方式绘制，</p>
<p>ComputeShader直接通过RWTexture2D可避免这一问题。</p>
<p><a href="https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/desktop/direct3dhlsl/sm5-object-rwtexture2d" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/desktop/direct3dhlsl/sm5-object-rwtexture2d</a></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>插件中使用了这个技巧进行优化，在ShapeCombine.compute中，但缺点是不能进行双线性采样等方式，只能手写。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>6.3&nbsp;OceanDepthCache</h2>
<p>该脚本创建ODC深度信息，从而实现浅水区等效果。该脚本有一套完善的俯视角相机、参数创建逻辑，</p>
<p>可参考使用（实际上很多效果都需要俯视角相机，照搬比较正规的做法还是有必要的）。</p>
<p>在Examples.unity的River/DepthCache Demo中有具体使用。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>6.4 Validate验证系统</h2>
<p>该插件有一套自己的验证系统。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>public interface<span> IValidated
{
    bool<span> Validate(OceanRenderer ocean, ValidatedHelper.ShowMessage showMessage);
}</span></span></pre>
</div>
<p>当参数配置缺失或错误时，该验证系统将通过showMessage函数跳出报错GUI，以方便使用。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/519009/202512/519009-20251215161548940-498149805.png" alt="z4" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>6.5&nbsp;EmbeddedAssetHelpers</h2>
<p>直接在MonoBehaviour上显示和编辑ScriptableObject对象参数，用的Cinemachine实现</p>
<p>EmbeddedAssetHelpers.cs</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>// This file is subject to the Unity Companion License:
// https://github.com/Unity-Technologies/com.unity.cinemachine/blob/593fa283bee378322337e5d9f5a7b91331a45799/LICENSE.md

// Lovingly adapted from Cinemachine:
// https://github.com/Unity-Technologies/com.unity.cinemachine/blob/593fa283bee378322337e5d9f5a7b91331a45799/Editor/Utility/EmbeddedAssetHelpers.cs</pre>
</div>
